title: Physics-lite
purpose: Give action and effects believable weight, contact and response, and write down every stylised exception with its reason, so 'anime physics' is a choice and not a model error.
use_cases: Writing a hit as anticipation, contact, follow-through and recovery, with the heavier body moving less.
Giving effects a response: fire lights nearby faces, rain darkens fabric and makes ground reflective, smoke drifts with the wind.
Recording a stylised exception per shot (a hang time in a jump, an impossible speed line) with the reason (a power reveal).
Checking contact: feet on the ground plane, hands on the object they hold, no hovering or sinking.
anti_patterns: Impacts with no anticipation or recoil; the hit has no weight.
Light effects (fire, magic, screens) that do not light anything around them.
Water and smoke that ignore wind direction set in the same scene.
Feet sliding on the ground during a walk cycle, or a held object drifting from the hand.
Breaking physics in every shot, so the one exception that should matter does not stand out.

checks.measure: every `physics` entry with an `exception` has a `reason`
action plan: axis, props, contact and flash rate
reviewer checks a frame strip for feet and hand contact
checks.pass: no sliding, hovering or drifting held objects

checks.measure: for a light-emitting effect, reviewer shows the lit surfaces around it
checks.pass: at least one nearby surface responds
